assumptions.description: Generate 3000 independent whole-cohort rows and required columns; seed controls one draw; identifiers encode author/seed/index. No participant input.
Transport pooled rounded Pinggu BMI/glucose/HbA1c moments and sex composition to 2009 selected task sample age35-74; region, period, clinical mix and common-complete-case selection differ.

Numerical identity from fasting source plasma glucose to target central-serum glucose; target source-equivalent fasting is not established. HbA1c percent treated comparable despite incomplete P1 assay details. This is a transfer assumption, not certified measurement equivalence.
P1 exhaustive DR strata combined with (n-1) within and n between mean sums over N-1. Reported inputs rounded; choose usual sample-SD convention; no new precision implied.
Discrete uniform integer age35-74 because target composition and applicable source-age eligibility unknown; ignore P1 pooled age summary.
Gaussian copula for age/logBMI/log shifted glucose; latent order A,B,G; normal latents give lognormal margins, not reported tail shape.
Latent age-BMI correlation zero and female independent of all three predictor latents. Unsupported simplifying choices; P3 sex differences are not reproduced.
Shifted lognormal glucose support begins at assumed c=2.5 mmol/L; this is not a reported source minimum.

Use P2 Chinese-reference FPG0.493 and shared age0.005/female0.085 as reduced conditional-mean coefficients despite original waist/lipid/HOMA-IR/ethnicity interactions and known-diabetes exclusion. Omitted covariates absorbed into intercept/residual and stipulated covariances; not a source-equivalent OLS model.
Transport P2 pooled multiethnic unadjusted Pearson Corr(H,age)=.208 and Corr(H,logBMI)=.21 to task design; reported correlations do not identify target covariance.
Conditional H mean has zero direct BMI coefficient; assign borrowed marginal logBMI association through glucose as a structural statistical assumption, not a reported null or causal mediation.

Independent symmetric uniform residual, with variance algebraically chosen to preserve P1 H variance; bounded variation ensures H positivity. Residual dispersion is not source SE or model/evidence uncertainty.
One conditional law across unrepresented disease/treatment/pregnancy states; no exclusions of those states claimed. Homoscedasticity, independence and linearity are assumptions.

All supported source comparisons are approximate all-row calculations on actual task population, with no source-population reconstruction, reweighting or measurement conversion. Incompatible transformation or adjustment remains unavailable.
P3/P4 statistics and P2 FPG-H Pearson .79/R2 .632 are context, not additional model-fitting constraints; do not pool incompatible adjusted effects or source cohorts as independent precision.

Bounded age/sex/residual; lognormal B and shifted G have finite moments of every positive integer order; H affine. Positive-definite copula and nondegenerate predictors support nonsingular population OLS designs. Finite realized rows/rank remain untested.

Source flow inconsistency: 5157 examinations minus stated exclusions 325, 932 and 2 equals 3898, whereas reported analytic N and ethnic counts total 3895. Retain reported N=3895; unexplained difference of three, no invented exclusion and no model parameter depends on its resolution.

law.derivation: Reviewed distributional choices, not a source-reported joint law.

pooling_inputs.derivation: Exact rounded Table1 inputs and source stratum n=40/3084; n from table headings.

bmi.derivation: Pooled arithmetic m=sum(n*m)/N; v=[sum((n-1)*sd^2+n*(m-mpool)^2)]/(N-1). log_sd=sqrt(log(1+v/m^2)); exp centering preserves m and v.

glucose.derivation: Pooled arithmetic m=sum(n*m)/N; v=[sum((n-1)*sd^2+n*(m-mpool)^2)]/(N-1). Assume shift c=2.5; log_sd=sqrt(log(1+v/(m-c)^2)); shift+exp law preserves m and v.

coefficient_glucose.derivation: Use the reported point coefficient as a reduced-model setting; source CI/SE remain evidence uncertainty and are not residual SDs.

coefficient_age.derivation: Use the reported point coefficient as a reduced-model setting; source CI/SE remain evidence uncertainty and are not residual SDs.

coefficient_female.derivation: Use the reported point coefficient as a reduced-model setting; source CI/SE remain evidence uncertainty and are not residual SDs.

coefficient_direct_bmi.derivation: Structural zero; not a reported null.

correlation_constraints.derivation: Transport exact reported Pearson operands, including logBMI rather than BMI.

latent_correlation.derivation: rAB=0. CovAG=(.208*sA*sH-bA*vA)/bG. Solve CovAG=(mG-c)*(sum_a a*(Phi(z_hi-sigmaG*rAG)-Phi(z_lo-sigmaG*rAG))-54.5) using standard-normal age quantile intervals. rBG=.21*sH/[bG*(mG-c)*sigmaG]. Deterministic retained algebra; no rows.

analytic_audit.derivation: Deterministic consequences only: lower H=mH+bG*(c-mG)+bA*(35-54.5)-bF*pF-w; E1=bG*(mG-c)*mB*expm1(sigmaG*sigmaB*rBG)/vB; E2=bG; E3=bA. Not source estimates under task formulas or target findings.
